positions.name: MissingIdSlugFallbackRequirement
positions.frame: what must the derive-id path guarantee when a heading carries no id field?
positions.why: src-1 sets up the reproduction condition — a ## heading with no id field, mirroring the prod failure — and src-2 states the required outcome for that exact condition: no crash, and a valid slug produced. Read together, the two expressions describe one directional requirement on the missing-id fallback path rather than two independent claims; src-1 supplies the trigger, src-2 the guarantee that must hold under it.
